requiredAll: 2-call final behavioral success improves by at least 10 percentage points over 1-call
at least 15 percent of first failures recover on call 2
zero safety violations and zero wrong-file edits
preregisteredGate.thirdCallRule: Enable only if call 3 adds at least 5 percentage points over call 2 with new verifier evidence and no safety regression.
preregisteredGate.otherwise: Do not create E-ITER candidate; retain protocol as rejected development hypothesis.
